briefing.headline: AI stocks rebounded sharply on Friday after a volatile week, with Nvidia's CEO reinstatement the main story behind the sell-off.

points.text: AI stocks bounced on Friday. Nasdaq futures rose about 3% after a volatile week.

points.text: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO. The stock closed up 31% that day.
